title: H·AI·K·U Settings
description: Configuration schema for .haiku/settings.yml. Two load-bearing fields: studio (lifecycle template selection) and providers (external system contracts injected into prompts). All other fields are intentionally absent — earlier drafts carried VCS-strategy, mockup-format, archetype defaults, announcement choices, hat-to-model maps, infrastructure-stack blocks, and review-agent toggles that no engine code ever consumed. The cleanup landed 2026-05-19.

studio.description: The studio (lifecycle template) for this project. Studios define stage order, hats, review gates, and execution mode. Value must match a directory under plugin/studios/ or a project-overlay at .haiku/studios/. Examples: software, ideation.

providers.description: External-system provider configuration. Each provider's behavior contract is at plugin/providers/<kind>.md and is spliced into the relevant prompt phases when configured here. The git provider is always-on when in a git repo (no settings entry required).

drift_detection.description: Run the pre-tick drift sweep. Default true. Set to false to disable drift detection entirely (e.g., very-large repos where the sweep cost outweighs the safety benefit).

human_write_require_rationale.description: Require a `rationale:` field on every `haiku_human_write` call. Default false. Set to true to enforce that every human-authored write to engine-managed files carries a written justification for the audit log.

providersConfig.description: External-system provider configuration. Workflow providers (ticketing) get full operational control if the matching MCP tool is available, otherwise degrade to read-only-with-external_refs. Source providers (spec, knowledge, design) align H·AI·K·U intent + units to external content; read-only by default.

spec.description: Source provider — PRDs, RFCs, design docs (Notion, Confluence, Google Docs).

ticketing.description: Workflow provider — issue trackers (Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, GitLab Issues).

design.description: Source provider — design tools (Figma, Pencil, OpenPencil, Penpot, Excalidraw, Canva).

knowledge.description: Source provider — organizational memory (Notion, Confluence, Google Docs). Distinct from spec: knowledge spans intents; spec is per-intent.

config.description: Provider-specific configuration — schema determined by provider type.

instructions.description: Inline provider instructions (appended to the plugin default for this provider type).
